steps.title: Validate word and image discussion anchors
preconditions: A separate personal project and eight exact items are created through public HTTP using an existing synthetic fixture actor; no production account or provider is used.
Three-revision and two-revision image families are disjoint; a third unused image is tombstoned through a public leased command before rejection cases.
All requests are loopback-only, capped at 100 requests, 16 KiB request/64 KiB response, five-second timeout; existing parent has a 90-second owned-process deadline and denies Worker outbound traffic.

No claim of corrupt legacy lineage, cycle/depth rejection, pre-existing forked family threads, 1,000-word acceptance, guaranteed distinction between item-ID and thread-ID sort order, lease expiry, concurrent access changes, native UI, provider login, full line/branch execution or measured counters. The source remains uninstrumented in this service journey.
actions: POST commands seed eight independently authored items
POST threads reopen first-family root with different-family input anchor
POST threads reopen first-family middle with different-family input anchor
POST threads reopen first-family leaf with different-family input anchor
GET threads scope all limit 1 page 1
GET threads scope all limit 1 page 2
GET threads scope all limit 1 page 3
GET threads scope all limit 1 page 4

expectations.description: A three-version image family resolves through every revision to one root thread with the first leaf image anchor unchanged. A separate two-version family accepts an explicit same-family version. Reopening returns the exact original thread and adds no event or document mutation.

Ten malformed or unavailable anchor requests return exact 400 invalid_anchor: word-list type/size with the exact size-specific error body, missing or non-entry target, duplicate/foreign words, missing/non-image/deleted image, and a different image family. Each rejection preserves the complete public document snapshot excluding leases and the full previously verified event stream. Valid ordered word IDs, automatic image anchor and explicit family image anchor create exact thread/event objects.
Three threads page in observed thread-ID order with limit 1, exact hasMore/nextCursor values, and a final empty page. Listing preserves document fields excluding leases and the full event stream.
